WITH `genre_hours` AS (
  SELECT
    `genre`.`genre_id`,
    `genre`.`name` AS `genre_name`,
    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
    ON `playback_session`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
    ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
    ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` AS `series`
    ON `title`.`series_id` = `series`.`series_id`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`genre` AS `genre`
    ON `series`.`genre_id` = `genre`.`genre_id`
  WHERE `subscriber`.`service_tier` = 'Free'
    AND `genre`.`genre_id` IS NOT NULL
    AND `genre`.`name` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `genre`.`genre_id`, `genre`.`name`
), `ranked_genres` AS (
  SELECT
    `genre_id`,
    `genre_name`,
    `watch_hours`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC) AS `genre_rank`
  FROM `genre_hours`
)
SELECT
  `genre_id`,
  `genre_name`,
  `watch_hours`
FROM `ranked_genres`
WHERE `genre_rank` <= 3
ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC, `genre_id` ASC

  GROUP BY e.`title_id`
), top AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY watch_hours DESC) AS rk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sessions DESC) AS rk_sessions FROM v
)
SELECT top.rk AS watch_hours_rank, top.rk_sessions AS sessions_rank, t.`name` AS title, ROUND(top.watch_hours,0) AS watch_hours, top.sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.`active_flag` THEN w.`territory_id` END) AS countries_active_now,

  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.`active_flag` AND NOT COALESCE(w.`blackout_flag`,false) THEN w.`territory_id` END) AS countries_active_no_blackout,
  COUNT(DISTINCT w.`territory_id`) AS countries_ever,
  CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN w.`active_flag` THEN tr.`name` END))) AS active_countries

JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` t ON top.`title_id` = t.`title_id`

WITH monthly_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    m.month_start,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN subscription_plan.contract_term_months = 12 THEN TRY_DIVIDE(subscription.base_rate_amount, 12)
        ELSE subscription.base_rate_amount
      END
    ) AS mrr
  FROM (
    SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(DATE'2026-04-01', DATE'2026-10-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS month_start
  ) AS m
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS subscription
    ON subscription.subscription_status = 'Active'
   AND subscription.activation_date IS NOT NULL
   AND subscription.activation_date <= m.month_start
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS subscription_plan
    ON subscription.subscription_plan_id = subscription_plan.subscription_plan_id
  WHERE subscription_plan.plan_type = 'Paid'
  GROUP BY m.month_start
), growth_calc AS (
  SELECT
    monthly_mrr.month_start,
    monthly_mrr.mrr,
    LAG(monthly_mrr.mrr) OVER (ORDER BY monthly_mrr.month_start) AS previous_month_mrr
  FROM monthly_mrr
)
SELECT
  growth_calc.month_start,
  growth_calc.previous_month_mrr,
  growth_calc.mrr AS current_month_mrr,
  growth_calc.mrr - growth_calc.previous_month_mrr AS mrr_change,
  100 * TRY_DIVIDE(growth_calc.mrr - growth_calc.previous_month_mrr, growth_calc.previous_month_mrr) AS mom_mrr_growth_percent
FROM growth_calc
WHERE growth_calc.month_start >= DATE'2026-05-01'
  AND growth_calc.month_start < DATE'2026-11-01'
ORDER BY growth_calc.month_start

WITH `signup_cohort` AS (
  SELECT
    `subscription`.`subscriber_id`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  WHERE `subscription`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `subscription`.`subscriber_id`
  HAVING MIN(`subscription`.`activation_date`) >= DATE'2026-01-01'
     AND MIN(`subscription`.`activation_date`) < DATE'2026-04-01'
),
`active_paid_today` AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    `subscription`.`subscriber_id`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
    ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
    AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT `signup_cohort`.`subscriber_id`) AS `q1_joiners`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT `active_paid_today`.`subscriber_id`) AS `currently_on_paid_plan`,
  try_divide(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT `active_paid_today`.`subscriber_id`),COUNT(DISTINCT `signup_cohort`.`subscriber_id`)) AS `pct_on_paid_plan_today`
FROM `signup_cohort`
LEFT JOIN `active_paid_today`
  ON `signup_cohort`.`subscriber_id` = `active_paid_today`.`subscriber_id`

WITH `first_subscription` AS (
  SELECT
    `s`.`subscriber_id`,
    `s`.`activation_date` AS `first_activation_date`,
    `sp`.`plan_type` AS `first_plan_type`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY `s`.`subscriber_id`
      ORDER BY `s`.`activation_date`, `s`.`subscription_id`
    ) AS `rn`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `s`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `sp`
    ON `s`.`subscription_plan_id` = `sp`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `s`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `sp`.`plan_type` IS NOT NULL
), `free_starters` AS (
  SELECT
    `subscriber_id`,
    `first_activation_date`
  FROM `first_subscription`
  WHERE `rn` = 1
    AND `first_plan_type` = 'Free'
), `first_paid_upgrade` AS (
  SELECT
    `s`.`subscriber_id`,
    MIN(`s`.`activation_date`) AS `first_paid_activation_date`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `s`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `sp`
    ON `s`.`subscription_plan_id` = `sp`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `s`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `sp`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  GROUP BY `s`.`subscriber_id`
)
SELECT
  percentile_approx(datediff(`p`.`first_paid_activation_date`, `f`.`first_activation_date`), 0.5) AS `median_days_on_free_before_upgrading`,
  COUNT(*) AS `upgraded_subscribers`
FROM `free_starters` AS `f`
JOIN `first_paid_upgrade` AS `p`
  ON `f`.`subscriber_id` = `p`.`subscriber_id`
WHERE `p`.`first_paid_activation_date` > `f`.`first_activation_date`;

WITH plan_payment_stats AS (
  SELECT
    subscription_plan.subscription_plan_id,
    subscription_plan.plan_name,
    try_divide(
      SUM(CASE WHEN payment.payment_status = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      COUNT(*)
    ) AS payment_failure_rate
  FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_billing.payment AS payment
  INNER JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_billing.invoice AS invoice
    ON payment.invoice_id = invoice.invoice_id
  INNER JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS subscription_plan

),

WITH monthly_country_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice.invoice_date) AS month,
    territory.name AS country,
    SUM(invoice.subtotal_amount - invoice.discount_amount) AS revenue_without_tax
  FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_billing.invoice AS invoice
  INNER JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS subscription_plan
    ON invoice.subscription_plan_id = subscription_plan.subscription_plan_id
  INNER JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS subscriber
    ON invoice.subscriber_id = subscriber.subscriber_id
  INNER JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS territory
    ON subscriber.territory_id = territory.territory_id
  WHERE invoice.invoice_date IS NOT NULL
    AND territory.name IS NOT NULL
    AND subscription_plan.plan_type = 'Paid'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice.invoice_date), territory.name
),
months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT monthly_country_revenue.month
  FROM monthly_country_revenue
),
monthly_country_paying_subscribers AS (
  SELECT
    months.month AS month,
    territory.name AS country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subscription.subscriber_id) AS paying_subscribers
  FROM months
  INNER JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription AS subscription
    ON subscription.activation_date <= LAST_DAY(months.month)
   AND (subscription.termination_date IS NULL OR subscription.termination_date >= months.month)
  INNER JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS subscription_plan
    ON subscription.subscription_plan_id = subscription_plan.subscription_plan_id
  INNER JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS subscriber
    ON subscription.subscriber_id = subscriber.subscriber_id
  INNER JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS territory
    ON subscriber.territory_id = territory.territory_id
  WHERE months.month IS NOT NULL
    AND territory.name IS NOT NULL
    AND subscription.subscription_status = 'Active'
    AND subscription_plan.plan_type = 'Paid'
  GROUP BY months.month, territory.name
),
country_average_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    monthly_country_revenue.country,
    AVG(try_divide(monthly_country_revenue.revenue_without_tax, monthly_country_paying_subscribers.paying_subscribers)) AS avg_monthly_revenue_per_paying_subscriber
  FROM monthly_country_revenue
  INNER JOIN monthly_country_paying_subscribers
    ON monthly_country_revenue.month = monthly_country_paying_subscribers.month
   AND monthly_country_revenue.country = monthly_country_paying_subscribers.country
  WHERE monthly_country_paying_subscribers.paying_subscribers > 0
  GROUP BY monthly_country_revenue.country
),
ranked_countries AS (
  SELECT
    country_average_metrics.country,
    country_average_metrics.avg_monthly_revenue_per_paying_subscriber,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY country_average_metrics.avg_monthly_revenue_per_paying_subscriber DESC) AS country_rank
  FROM country_average_metrics
)
SELECT
  ranked_countries.country,
  ranked_countries.avg_monthly_revenue_per_paying_subscriber
FROM ranked_countries
WHERE ranked_countries.country_rank <= 3
ORDER BY ranked_countries.avg_monthly_revenue_per_paying_subscriber DESC, ranked_countries.country;

WITH viewer_watch AS (
  SELECT
    `playback_session`.`subscriber_id` AS `subscriber_id`,
    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  WHERE `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP('2026-10-01 00:00:00')
    AND `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP('2026-11-01 00:00:00')
    AND `playback_session`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `playback_session`.`subscriber_id`
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    `subscriber_id`,
    `watch_hours`,
    SUM(`watch_hours`) OVER (ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC, `subscriber_id`) AS `cumulative_watch_hours`,
    SUM(`watch_hours`) OVER () AS `total_watch_hours`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC, `subscriber_id`) AS `viewer_rank`,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS `total_viewers`
  FROM viewer_watch
), threshold AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(`viewer_rank`) AS `viewers_for_half_watch_hours`,
    MAX(`total_viewers`) AS `total_viewers`
  FROM ranked
  WHERE `cumulative_watch_hours` >= 0.5 * `total_watch_hours`
)
SELECT
  `viewers_for_half_watch_hours`,
  `total_viewers`,
  100.0 * TRY_DIVIDE(`viewers_for_half_watch_hours`, `total_viewers`) AS `viewer_percentage_for_half_watch_hours`
FROM threshold;

  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`campaign` c
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`advertiser` a ON c.advertiser_id = a.advertiser_id
  WHERE lower(a.trade_name) LIKE '%larkspur%' OR lower(a.legal_name) LIKE '%larkspur%'),
d AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, SUM(total_impressions_served) AS delivered
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery`
  GROUP BY campaign_id)
SELECT COALESCE(c.campaign_type, 'All objectives') AS campaign_objective,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.campaign_id) AS campaigns,
  SUM(c.target_impressions) AS ordered_impressions,
  SUM(COALESCE(d.delivered, 0)) AS delivered_impressions,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(d.delivered, 0)) / SUM(c.target_impressions), 3) AS delivery_ratio,
  concat_ws(', ', collect_set(c.trade_name)) AS advertiser
FROM c LEFT JOIN d ON c.campaign_id = d.campaign_id
GROUP BY ROLLUP(c.campaign_type)
ORDER BY c.campaign_type IS NULL, c.campaign_type
